title: International Math Bowl
text:
The International Math Bowl (IMB) is an online, global, team-based math competition for high school students (but younger participants and solo competitors are also encouraged to join).

The website for the competition can be found here: https://www.internationalmathbowl.com/.

Format[edit]

Open Round

The open round is a 60-minute, 25-question exam to be done by all participating teams. Teams can choose any hour-long time period during competition week to take the exam.

Final (Bowl) Round

The top 32 teams from the Open Round are invited to compete in the Final (Bowl) Round. This round consists of a buzzer-style tournament pitting the top-rated teams head-on-head to crown the champion.

Registration[edit]

Teams and individuals wishing to participate in the competition can register at https://www.internationalmathbowl.com/register. There is no fee for this competition.
